scenes.headline: How Laya scores options, and what Apple silicon freezes
scenes.sub: Two ports of one decision model: MLX, and a Neural Engine graph.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Miso! Laya is a small model that picks between options. Two ports bring it to Apple silicon. Here's how it works there.

scenes.label: The finding
scenes.text: Laya scores every option in one pass, as markers in one sequence. Exporting it for the Neural Engine welds the option count into the graph.
scenes.mark: welds the option count into the graph
scenes.say: Laya scores every option in a single pass. But exporting it for the Neural Engine welds the number of options into the graph itself.

scenes.title: One sequence, one pass, every option

steps.say: A question and its options are packed into one sequence, with a marker token standing in for each option.
A bidirectional ModernBERT encoder reads the whole sequence, once.

steps.note: cost grows with the packed length
steps.say: One shared head reads a score at every marker, and the scores become a choice. Cost grows with the length of the packed sequence.

left.title: MLX port
items: Batches a Snake move's three questions at once
left.say: The MLX port reimplements the model natively. It keeps lengths flexible, and batches a Snake move's three questions into one forward pass.

right.title: Neural Engine graph
right.say: The Core ML port hand-writes a graph for the Neural Engine: channel-first layout, one-by-one convolutions, static masks. Everything lands in fixed buffers.

scenes.label: Published bundles, and where each froze its option count
scenes.say: Every one of the six published bundles freezes its option count. Five at thirty-two. The one that plays Snake, at four.

scenes.label: Neural Engine speed over compiled MLX, same machine, short inputs
scenes.note: the 50× that travelled is a round trip over a local call
scenes.say: The fifty-times claim that travelled divides a hosted round trip by a local call. The repo's own ratio, on one machine, is one point three nine four.

scenes.text: Going closer to the metal costs more of the shape. A fixed graph is a bet on your traffic.
scenes.say: Going closer to the metal costs more of the shape. A fixed graph is a bet on the shape of your traffic.

recap: Options are markers in one shared sequence
MLX batches; the Neural Engine graph is fixed
The option count is frozen in every bundle
scenes.say: To recap: one pass over every option, a flexible port and a fixed one, and an option count frozen into the shape.
